title: Refill Confirmation Rules for Coverage-Billed Supplies — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
## Section 1 — when a shipment must rest on a refill request (in force)

On a schedule of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program that does not allow automatic shipment, or for a patient who has not chosen automatic shipment, every shipment of coverage-billed items must rest on the patient's own refill request: the patient names the items wanted and, where the schedule requires the on-hand check, reports that the supply on hand of each is nearly exhausted. The request is accepted only through a channel the schedule accepts for refill confirmations.

| Situation | Must the coverage-billed shipment rest on the patient's own refill request? |
|---|---|
| The schedule does not allow automatic shipment | yes |
| The patient has not chosen automatic shipment | yes |

## Section 2 — items reported as not used up (in force)

An item the patient reports as not exhausted is not shipped, and the contact is recorded as declined.

## Section 3 — who may answer (in force)

A caregiver may answer for the patient only when listed on the profile. Summit Ridge never infers a request from silence.

## Section 4 — retired clauses

- "A refill is confirmed only on the patient's own statement of the items wanted and their supply status." — **no longer in force** for a refill request the patient places on a phone call, which is confirmed under the current basis. Every other refill confirmation remains under this clause.
- "Items are shipped no later than the schedule's refill lead days after the refill is confirmed, counting calendar days from the day after the contact date with the boundary day included; an older confirmation needs a new contact." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.

Sections 1 to 3 remain in force unchanged.

## Basis Q&A

**A patient on a schedule that allows automatic shipment has not chosen automatic shipment. Does a coverage-billed shipment need the patient's own request?** Yes. Either a schedule without automatic shipment or a patient without the automatic-shipment choice brings the shipment under Section 1.

**On a schedule that requires the on-hand check, the patient names headgear and says it still has useful life. Is it shipped?** No. An item reported as not exhausted is not shipped, and the contact is recorded as declined.

**A relative calls to ask for supplies but is not listed on the patient's profile. Is a request taken?** No. A caregiver may answer for the patient only when listed on the profile.

**A patient confirms a refill through the patient portal. Which wording governs the confirmation?** The first clause of Section 4 still governs it, because it is not a request placed on a phone call: the refill is confirmed only on the patient's own statement of the items wanted and their supply status.

**The patient did not reply to a refill reminder. Is a request recorded?** No. Summit Ridge never infers a request from silence.

superseded_clauses: A refill is confirmed only on the patient's own statement of the items wanted and their supply status.

Items are shipped no later than `refill_contact_lead_days` after the refill is confirmed, counting calendar days from the day after contact_date with the boundary day included; an older confirmation needs a new contact.
